rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Convenience-driven prompts with known shape-bias get body acknowledgment callout
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm the rule guards: a student who blind-trusts the integrate-branch prompt could lose their prior CLAUDE.local.md rules to a silent overwrite, with the loss becoming permanent once the session's scrollback is gone. The body callout at the ae101-m2-integrate-branch prompt names the bias (a) and gives a post-hoc rescue, but stops short of the rule's third beat: an opt-in harsher alternative offered BEFORE running (e.g. 'ask to see the diff first' as a stated option). Harm is present but small — the rescue already covers the actual loss scenario while the scrollback survives, so this is a real but modest gap, not a live unrecovered risk.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: One optional line before the prompt, e.g. 'if you want to check first, ask Claude to show the diff before saving' — offered, not mandated, consistent with §10 student agency.
